archetypes.name: dyn-dialectic-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Gate C dialectic spans drafter parsing, postplan promotion, stale clearing, and tail presentation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed dialectic clarifier lifecycle across drafter parsing, postplan promotion, stale clearing, and Gate C tail invocation. Focus on stale artifact handling, skip-approve behavior, process lifecycle fail-open semantics, and whether digest output remains display-only. Check that manual debate artifacts cannot cause stale or duplicate Gate C presentation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
